scope: Visual inspection of local Chromium captures at 1440 x 1000. This is not source pixel parity, human language/domain acceptance, native-device or assistive-technology review.

reviewed.observations: Settled review step displays identity/contact/payment summaries, wristband preview and navigation/save actions without visible overlap.
Patient context, visit types, selected complaint and complaint suggestions render with readable text and a bounded popup.
Mounted editor retains its value under the accepted midnight theme, Plex font, zero radius and changed form scale; product wristband geometry remains rounded.
Patient insurance filters, search results and wristband/coverage context remain separated into readable scrollable panels with record and encounter actions.
Final CI-build Today desk shows the registered fictional patient and completed outpatient encounter in the counter queue; search, follow-up and admission panels remain readable.

captureNote: MedBand workflow screenshots disable finite animation capture to avoid recording a partially faded transition. Early diagnostic captures are retained in separate folders.
